title: Fernand Point's Crispy Pommes Dauphine (Potato & Choux Puffs)
originalTitle: Fernand Point's Crispy Pommes Dauphine (Potato & Choux Puffs)
ingredients: 1 lb Russet or Yukon Gold potatoes (peeled, boiled or baked, and passed through a potato ricer while hot)
Choux Pastry (Pâte à Choux): 1/2 cup (120ml) water, 4 tbsp (55g) unsalted butter, 1/2 tsp salt, pinch of freshly grated nutmeg
Neutral oil (peanut or canola) for deep-frying at 350°F (175°C)
instructions: Boil or bake the potatoes until fork-tender, pass immediately through a fine ricer or tamis so no lumps remain, and let steam off excess moisture.

Make the Pâte à Choux: Bring water, butter, salt, and nutmeg to a boil in a saucepan. Dump in all the flour at once and stir vigorously over medium heat for 2 minutes until a smooth ball pulls away from the pan and leaves a thin film on the bottom.
Transfer the hot dough to a bowl and beat in the eggs one at a time until glossy and smooth. Fold the warm riced potato into the choux paste (roughly 2 parts potato to 1 part choux).
Scoop or pipe walnut-sized quenelles into 350°F (175°C) oil and fry for 4–5 minutes until puffed, airy, and deep golden brown. Drain on paper towels and season immediately with fine sea salt.
